description: This file implements the Redis-based clustering membership table for Orleans, handling membership entries, reading and writing cluster node information, and managing synchronization via Redis transactions.

classes.name: RedisMembershipTable
classes.description: Implements the IMembershipTable interface using Redis backend for Orleans clustering, managing membership entries, and cluster state synchronization.

methods.name: DeleteMembershipTableEntries
methods.description: Deletes all membership entries for a specific cluster.

methods.name: InitializeMembershipTable
methods.description: Initializes the Redis connection and sets up the membership table, optionally initializing the table version.

methods.name: InsertRow
methods.description: Inserts a membership entry into the Redis table.

methods.name: UpdateIAmAlive
methods.description: Updates the IAmAlive timestamp for a given membership entry.

methods.name: ReadAll
methods.description: Reads all membership entries and current table version from Redis.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific membership entry identified by SiloAddress.

methods.name: CleanupDefunctSiloEntries
methods.description: Removes silos that are not active and have been unresponsive before a certain date.
